compute_diff_images: compute the difference between two images with configurable offset and normalization
load_pickle_dataset: load a tactile sensor dataset from a pickle file and return all frames
load_sample_from_buf: load and preprocess a tactile image from binary buffer with background removal and enhancement
enhance_image: enhance a tactile sensor image by adjusting brightness and contrast parameters
load_dataset_forces: load force and slip datasets for digit or gelsight tactile sensors from pickle files
